specs.title: admin deletion requires reason and sends it to server
failed deletion keeps the dialog open for correction
classified deletion does not require optional detail
review and reply deletion preserve threads and use common deletion APIs

public administrator deletion uses classified history API for POST
public administrator deletion uses classified history API for COMMENT
public administrator deletion uses classified history API for COMMUNITY_POST
public administrator deletion uses classified history API for COMMUNITY_COMMENT
deleted review restoration is based on server history ADMIN
deleted review restoration is based on server history AUTHOR
deleted review restoration is based on server history RESTORED
deleted review restoration is based on server history NO_HISTORY
report deletion sends inquiryId and refreshes answer for FESTIVAL
report deletion sends inquiryId and refreshes answer for POST
report deletion sends inquiryId and refreshes answer for COMMENT
report deletion sends inquiryId and refreshes answer for COMMUNITY_POST
report deletion sends inquiryId and refreshes answer for COMMUNITY_COMMENT
duplicate restoration error stays visible inside event management dialog
restore is based on deletion actor ADMIN, not event source
restore is based on deletion actor AUTHOR, not event source
restore is based on deletion actor UNKNOWN, not event source
province filters carry from home, restore URLs and reset
